title: FIXED: Fold button now detected
content:
Fixed the Fold button detection in dynamic_table_finder.py.

PROBLEM: Fold button was never being detected because BUTTON_COLORS didn't include it.
The comment said "Fold is detected separately" but no code existed.

FIX: Added fold color detection:
    'fold': {
        'lower': np.array([0, 0, 40]),
        'upper': np.array([180, 50, 120]),
        'name': 'Fold'
    }

VERIFIED WORKING: Now detects fold at (215, 544) on test table.
